say:8:1120629005:1.text: The same as the stories I grew up with... Roaming freely across the land in search of treasure, telling stories in taverns, and singing drunk songs with strangers all night.
say:8:1120629005:1.source_cn: 像我之前故事里的那样：寻宝时在广阔的天地间自由自在，在...

say:9:1120629006:1.text: But the truth is that danger and treasure-hunting go hand-in-hand.
say:9:1120629006:1.source_cn: 但现实中的寻宝，危险同时难以避免。

say:10:1120629007:1.text: I knew treasure hunters ran into their share of trouble, but I figured the worst of it was poisonous scorpions and the like...
say:10:1120629007:1.source_cn: 我知道宝藏猎人可能会遇见危险，但我一直以为最多是像毒蝎...

say:11:1120629008:1.text: I didn't realize that the greatest danger was the greed of the people around you. After all, the strong eat the weak out here...
say:11:1120629008:1.source_cn: 而不会是像现在这样，在弱肉强食的规则里，需要时刻警惕阴...

choice_prompt:12:1120629008.text: I didn't realize that the greatest danger was the greed of the people around you. After all, the strong eat the weak out here...
choice_prompt:12:1120629008.source_cn: 而不会是像现在这样，在弱肉强食的规则里，需要时刻警惕阴谋，分辨身边的贪婪。

say:13:1120629009:1.text: But treasure hunters can never live exactly like they do in the stories.
say:13:1120629009:1.source_cn: 但是宝藏猎人不可能活得和故事一样。

say:14:1120629010:1.text: You're right. After everything we've been through, I'm starting to see Father's views in a different light...
say:14:1120629010:1.source_cn: 是的，在经历过这些后，我对于父亲的看法，也开始变得复杂……

say:15:1120629011:1.text: I still resent him for leaving us to fend for ourselves, but I want to find him even more now.
say:15:1120629011:1.source_cn: 我仍然怨恨他一去不回，留下我们兄弟二人独自生活，可我现...

say:16:1120629012:1.text: After being gone for so long... I guess I do miss him a little. I also want to know how all of this came to happen.
say:16:1120629012:1.source_cn: 或许……在他失踪这么久后，我有些想他了。他也面对了我们...

say:17:1120629013:1.text: Let's keep searching his manuscript for clues, Evan. I'm sure we'll find him soon enough.
say:17:1120629013:1.source_cn: 继续沿着手稿上的线索寻找吧，我们一定会找到他的，艾文。
